data.name: Evil Eye
data.description: The shaman causes doubt to creep into the mind of a foe within 30 feet that she can see. The target takes a %1 penalty on one of the following (shaman's choice): ability checks, AC, attack rolls, saving throws, or skill checks. This hex lasts %2 rounds. A successful Will saving throw (DC %3) reduces this to just 1 round. This is a mind-affecting effect.|ShamanEvilEyeHexPenalty|ShamanEvilEyeHexDuration|ShamanEvilEyeHexDC
